svg.title: A human reading a language model agent's raw chat falls behind after two of six leaps. When the agent reports checkpoints in a language a human can read, three messages cover all six leaps
svg.desc: Two rows, 'raw chat' and 'checkpoints the agent reports', each pairing a search map on the left with a chat window on the right labeled 'the agent's messages'. On both maps a shaded region ruled out by tools blocks the direct diagonal between start and goal, and at each of the six steps of a language model agent a jagged ball, pale at its center with its mass out along its spikes, shows the distribution of next steps and one leap drawn from it. Top row ('raw chat'): in the chat window, six groups of four or five rounded teal bars, one group per leap, show the stream of messages, tool calls, and edits, running past the bottom edge of the window. The soft red area of what the human understands sits behind only the first two groups in the chat window and covers only the first two leaps on the map, read with six small red balls (three per leap). Past the second leap the chat goes unread and the agent's path zigzags sharply around the blocked region to the goal. Bottom row ('checkpoints the agent reports'): in the chat window, the six groups of raw chat bars are faint, and after every two leaps a checkpoint entry stands out as a red square followed by a single teal bar, with the soft red area behind the three entries only. On the map, the three matching red checkpoint squares sit at leaps two, four, and six, each read with one red ball, the soft red area covers the entire route, and the detour runs smooth to the goal.
